Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<fDecl>

<fDecl> (feature declaration) declares a single feature, specifying its name, organization, range of allowed values, and optionally its default value.
Attributes (In addition to global attributes)
name indicates the name of the feature being declared; matches the name attribute of <f> elements in the text.
Datatype: NMTOKEN
Values: any string of characters
Default: #REQUIRED
Example: 








org

  (organization)
specifies the organizing discipline of the feature value.




Datatype: (unit | set | bag | list)





Legal values are:



unit 
unitary atomic value




set 
set value (unordered, no duplicates)




bag 
bag value (unordered, may have duplicates)




list 
list value (ordered, may have duplicates)











Default: unit






Example: 












Example








Module
Declared in file teifsd2; Additional tag set for feature structures: enabled by TEI.fs





Data Description
May contain character data and phrase-level elements.




May contain
fDescr vDefault vRange 




May occur within
fsDecl 




Declaration

<!ELEMENT fDecl %om.RR;  (fDescr?, vRange, vDefault?)> 
<!ATTLIST fDecl  
      %a.global;
      name NMTOKEN #REQUIRED
      org (unit | set | bag | list) "unit">
